verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users start Copilot cloud agent tasks, or assign issues to Copilot, and these run autonomously in the cloud until a ready-to-review pull request comes back. Users can track progress from the phone. However, these are one-off agent tasks the user kicks off by hand; nothing shows configuring recurring, scheduled or event-triggered automations from the app. Missing for 10: setting up scheduled/triggered recurring automations, documentation of background-execution behavior and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Tasks on mobile.
